description:
Delete a file, as the project's owner, a collaborator or someone its
    ``edit_policy`` lets edit its files. index.html, where the project opens,
    cannot be deleted, and nothing can while the project is held for a site
    admin's review (``CONFLICT``).

filename.description: The file's name within the project, e.g. index.html or app.js.
filename.title: Filename

name: colony_delete_project_file
